title: You.com Launches Inference Router with 99.9% Uptime SLA for LLMs
summary:
Enterprise users can now access multiple AI models including GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash through a single API that eliminates platform fees. You.com's new Inference Router hosts these models on 100% US-based infrastructure and includes integrated web search to support on-demand inference through an OpenAI-compatible interface.

The service provides a minimum uptime SLA of 99.9% backed by service credits for outages. To meet corporate security and compliance standards, the router implements zero data retention across every model call and web search request and utilizes multi-provider failover.
